Abstract. We prove that the birational automorphism group of a general Calabi-yau complete intersection X given by ample divisors in pe xx pa is always Lorentzain. Applying the Kawamata-Morrison cone theorem on such X, we compute voly (D + sA) for any divisor D € JEH(X) and ample divisor A when s is small. We also provide examples of volumes of certain Cartier divisors that involve the digamma function.
